title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：net　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 net 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the fisherman ① casted the net that no boatman in the harbour would have measured, and he said the casting was the whole of the season. The ② net, meaning the mesh itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a net, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ net in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ net at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A net, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the fisherman said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the net was the whole of the matter, meaning the trap and not the mesh. The ⑥ net, meaning the trap and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; net, he said, is either something you cast or the only word that means both a mesh and a trap. He said the trap is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ net had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ net of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of measuring; net, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ net I remember is the mesh measured in the logbook, which closed in 1972 and is still measured as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ net, my mother said in 1974, is the only mesh that improves by being measured; every net, she said, is a trap that has agreed to look like a mesh. She said the trap was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 网（指渔港里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 网（指那张网本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：cast the net 撒这一张网
D. n. 网（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 网之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的网之事）
F. n. 网（指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一张）
G. n. 网、圈套（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 圈套（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: casted the net that no boatman in the harbour would have measured
The net, meaning the mesh itself and not the net
the net at the far pier
the net was the whole of the matter
the net had become a line in a logbook
The net of the whole thing
A net, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: cast the net 意为“撒这一张网”，1965 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯测量的一张网做了一遍。
net 意为“网”，指那张网本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被测量。
net 意为“网”，指渔港里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
net 意为“网”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
net 意为“网、圈套”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张圈套就是那件事的全部。
net 意为“圈套”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张网，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
net 意为“网”，指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一张，到 1970 年这一张成了航海日志里的一行。
net 意为“网之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的网之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的测量。
net 意为“网”，我记得的是航海日志里测量过的那一张，1972 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一张。
net 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，网是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的网。

items: 1965 年那位渔人撒了渔港里没有一位船工肯测量的一张网，他说这一遍才是那个汛期的全部。（cast the net）
那张网，指的是那张网本身而不是小小的渔网，经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被测量。（net）
那处渔港里每一张网旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。（net）
最远那座码头那张网，指的是他们留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（net）
叔叔说这张圈套就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那张网。（net）
